events.description: The Veterans Memorial Community Center's indoor aquatic center in Inver Grove Heights — a leisure pool with zero-depth entry, water slides, and interactive play features, plus a lap pool. A southeast-metro rainy-day swim; confirm current open-swim schedule.
events.address: 8055 Barbara Ave, Inver Grove Heights, MN

events.title: Historic Eidem Farm
events.description: City-run 1890s living-history farm on 19 acres in Brooklyn Park — heritage farm animals, a natural playground, trails, and a secret garden. Free self-guided Open Gate visits; seasonal (typically open summer). Confirm current hours.

events.title: Brooklyn Center Community Center
events.description: Brooklyn Center's indoor aquatics center — a 50-meter pool with a 150-foot water slide and a zero-depth wading pool for little ones, with public open-swim times; a northwest-metro rainy-day swim. Confirm the current open-swim schedule.
events.address: 6301 Shingle Creek Pkwy, Brooklyn Center, MN

events.title: Hjemkomst Center
events.description: City-run heritage museum on the Red River housing a full-scale replica Viking ship (the Hjemkomst, sailed to Norway in 1982) and a hand-built Norwegian stave church replica, plus rotating exhibits from the Historical & Cultural Society of Clay County.

events.title: Pahl's Market
events.description: Apple Valley garden center and market whose Fall Festival (mid-September through October 31) features a giant corn pit, bounce houses, a pallet maze, a pumpkin patch, and a toddler sandbox. Admission ~$10/child single-day or $25 season pass; adults free with a paid child - confirm current pricing and hours.

events.title: Apple Jack Orchards
events.description: Delano apple orchard and market with pick-your-own apples (First Kiss, SweeTango, Honeycrisp, Zestar!), a themed kids' maze, pumpkins, a bakery, and fall family activities. Open 10am-5pm daily in season.

events.title: Deardorff Orchards & Vineyards
events.description: Family-owned Waconia orchard and winery with 10 apple varieties over 3,000 trees, pick-your-own apples and pumpkins, tractor wagon rides, a petting farm, kids' haystacks, and picnic areas on weekends.

events.title: Dehn's Pumpkins
events.description: Dayton pick-your-own pumpkin patch (opens mid-September) with hayrides, pedal tractors, a corn maze, weekend pony rides, and a food booth serving hot cheese curds and mini donuts.

events.title: Whistling Well Farm
events.description: Hastings pick-your-own apple orchard along the St. Croix with a Red Barn farm store, pumpkins, and mums. Main farm open Thursday-Sunday and the store daily in season (from early September).
events.address: 8973 St Croix Trail S, Hastings, MN 55033

events.title: Fireside Orchard & Gardens
events.description: Northfield orchard growing 27 apple varieties, with pumpkins, cider, fresh donuts, caramel apples, and display rose, perennial, and water gardens. Open daily 9am-6pm, August through December.

events.title: White Pine Berry Farm
events.description: River Falls fall farm with a corn maze, pick-your-own pumpkin patch, wagon rides, petting zoo, bounce house, pumpkin painting, and fall raspberry picking. Free admission; activity passes for the maze and Fall Family Zone.

events.title: Leisen Family Farm
events.description: River Falls sweet-corn and pumpkin farm with a pick-your-own pumpkin patch, craft barn, petting zoo, giant bounce houses, and gourd launching. Free admission; pay only for activities.
events.address: 452 Old Cemetery Rd, River Falls, WI 54022

events.title: Neumann Farms
events.description: Osceola family farm with a pick-your-own pumpkin patch, gourds, squash, corn stalks, and a stocked farm gift shop on the St. Croix Valley fall loop.

events.title: Pleasant Valley Orchard
events.description: Shafer orchard on the St. Croix Valley with 16 apple varieties for pick-your-own, scenic hayrides through the orchard, and hayrides to a pick-your-own pumpkin patch. Hayride tickets $4; under 3 free.

events.title: Afton Apple Orchard
events.description: 190+ acre orchard in Denmark Township near Hastings -- u-pick apples (13 varieties), strawberries and raspberries in summer, a corn maze, a pumpkin patch, Straw Mountain and a large play area in fall. U-pick season typically runs September through October with festival weekends; confirm current hours, crop availability and admission on the orchard's own site before visiting.

events.title: Joyer Adventure Farm at Waldoch Farm
events.description: Family-run garden center and adventure farm about 20 minutes north of the Twin Cities, with 20+ attractions including the Joyer Barnyard (farm animals and feeding), a low ropes course and the Zoom Mountain slide. Fall Fun -- pumpkin patch, corn maze and Acres of Fun -- began September 19, 2026 and runs through Halloween, with Flashlight Nights open until 9pm. Admission is ticketed; confirm current hours, closed days and pricing on the farm's own site.

events.title: The Museum of Russian Art (TMORA)
events.description: The only North American museum devoted to Russian art and culture, housed in a former church near Diamond Lake Rd and 35W. Rotating exhibitions of painting, textiles and decorative arts. Admission $15 adults, $13 seniors 65+, $5 students and active military, free for children 0-13 and members. Open Mon-Sat 10am-5pm, Sun 1pm-5pm.

events.title: Wild Rumpus Books
events.description: Beloved independent children's bookstore full of live animals (cats, birds, chinchillas, chickens) with a kid-sized purple door - a genuine destination for young readers. Runs in-person Saturday story times and three monthly kids'/teen book clubs: Booker T's Teen Book Club (in person, ages 13-17), Wild Things Book Club (Zoom, ages 6-9) and Purple Door Book Club (Zoom, ages 8-12). Browsing and story times are free. Closed Mondays - confirm current hours before visiting.

events.title: Valley Bookseller
events.description: Independent bookstore in downtown Stillwater with a children's section and family story-time programming (including the seasonal Storytime Trolley). Confirm current hours and the current story-time schedule before visiting.

events.title: Excelsior Bay Books
events.description: Independent bookstore near Lake Minnetonka with a hand-picked children's section and family story-time events (including the Excelsior Trolley storytime). Confirm current hours and the current story-time schedule before visiting.

events.title: Content Bookstore
events.description: Independent bookstore and toy shop in historic downtown Northfield with a dedicated "Kids' Content" space of books, toys and games for all ages. Confirm current hours before visiting.

events.title: Zenith Bookstore
events.description: Independent neighborhood bookstore in West Duluth with a children's section and regular author/community events - an all-weather stop on a Duluth family trip. Confirm current hours before visiting.

events.title: Beagle and Wolf Books & Bindery
events.description: Family-owned full-service independent bookstore in downtown Park Rapids with a children's section, public book groups, and a robust schedule of author visits and special events - a lake-country family stop. Confirm current hours before visiting.

events.title: The Great Pumpkin Trail at Pinehaven Farm

events.title: Art Exhibit: “Spooky Waters of the World” by Geo Rutherford
events.description: Geo Rutherford is a Sauk City, Wisconsin based artist, author, educator and a social media sensation with a keen interest in science, natural history, and telling stories about water. On display are original illustrations from her New York Times best selling book Spooky Lakes (2024) and from her forthcoming book Spooky Rivers (2026). Her illustrations explore fascinating, quirky, and sometimes eerie stories about the Great Lakes and other fascinating bodies of water around the world. Her prints and stories are both educational and entertaining, and have earned her more than 2 million followers

events.title: Backyard Birding (all ages)
events.description: Migration is done and Minnesota is left with our winter residents. Our of the approximately 240 bird species that nest here in the summer only about 40 call Minnesota all year-round making late fall and winter and excellent time to learn the basics of birding. A 1-mile walk will be included in the program. Dress for the weather. Path taken will be a mixture of asphalt and mowed grass. Meet at the visitor center.

People request expungement when they have been denied employment, housing, or a professional license due to a criminal incident that appears on a background check. Winona Figure Drawing Sessions are held Tuesdays from 6:00pm to 8:00pm , upstairs at the Winona Arts Center located at 228 E 5th St., Winona, MN 55987 (the corner of 5th St. and Franklin St.). events.title: Live Music: Organic Music Cooperative Acoustic Jam
events.description: Trempealeau Hotel. The Organic Music Cooperative is back to bring us all together again through song and good vibes. Join this every-other-Tuesday get together of acoustic musicians at the Trempealeau Hotel, Restaurant and Saloon. Taco Tuesday and other tasty vittles 4-8. Music and mischief starts around 6:30. Bring your instruments and your hungry and thirsty friends! Play, sing, tap the bar or just take it all in and keep the song in your heart. Let’s give them a very warm welcome.

events.description: Water | Craft explores the intersection of traditional craft practices and contemporary concerns about water and the environment. events.title: Art Exhibit: “The Coast and the Sea – Marine and Maritime Art in America”
events.description: The Coast & the Sea: Marine and Maritime Art in America is a traveling exhibition organized by the The New York Historical featuring 49 paintings and 10 maritime objects from their immense collection relating the story of early American culture and history. The exhibition is organized into several chronological themes exploring America’s relationship with water. Paintings dating from 1750 to 1904 include seascapes, ship portraits, harbors, storms, naval battles, shipwrecks, as well scenes of leisure and portraits of historic people along with personal possessions such as navigational instrumen

events.title: Art Exhibit: “Spooky Waters of the World” by Geo Rutherford
events.description: Geo Rutherford is a Sauk City, Wisconsin based artist, author, educator and a social media sensation with a keen interest in science, natural history, and telling stories about water. On display are original illustrations from her New York Times best selling book Spooky Lakes (2024) and from her forthcoming book Spooky Rivers (2026). Her illustrations explore fascinating, quirky, and sometimes eerie stories about the Great Lakes and other fascinating bodies of water around the world. Her prints and stories are both educational and entertaining, and have earned her more than 2 million followers

events.title: Art Exhibit: “Home(town)” by Andy DuCett
events.description: Using the idea of a river town as a starting point, Andy DuCett will create multiple new site-specific installations for the Minnesota Marine Art Museum that start in the galleries but extend beyond the walls of the museum and into Winona, his hometown community, in the exhibition Home(town). Working across many artistic mediums, DuCett has a long history of fusing institutional presentation methods and languages with hyper-local visual and cultural vernacular. His work is often an invitation to literally participate, inviting the viewer to find familiar subjects and forms in unfamiliar arrang

events.description: Barbara McIlrath travels along the Mississippi River between her farm studio in Pepin, Wisconsin and her house in St. Paul, Minnesota. events.title: Mick Sterling Presents: A Grand Ole Opry Christmas
events.description: Paradise Center for the Arts. @ Mick Sterling Presents: A Grand Ole Opry Christmas Friday, December 18th at 7:30 PM A Grand Ole Opry Christmas honors the Christmas recordings of the pillars of Country and Rock and Roll in this joyous presentation! All of the classic Christmas songs and some really fun ones you may not be familiar with, joined by traditional gospel and spirituals, round out this wonderful presentation that has moved audiences for years. Featuring Mick Sterling, along with four more incredible lead vocalists, Cate Fierro, Shalo Lee, Lisi Wright, and Dan Neale. Show Sponsor: Fox

events.title: A Very Good Christmas Carol
events.description: Paradise Center for the Arts. @ A Very Good Christmas Carol Written and Performed by: Jeffrey Nolan & Hawken Paul Saturday, December 19th at 2:00 PM Join scrappy Dickensian orphans Edmund and Martin as they present their own version of A Christmas Carol! They may be the only two actors onstage, but with a trunk full of props, hearts full of song, and YOUR help, what could possibly go wrong? Come for a fresh, madcap take on a heartwarming classic, stay for the never-ending thrill of audience participation! At this event, three berths for each gender in the 2027 Men’s & Women’s Nationals, scheduled for January 24-30 at the MidAmerican Energy Company RecPlex in West Des Moines, IA, will be awarded. The winning men’s and women’s teams at the Nationals in Iowa will represent the United States in the 2027 World Men’s Championships and the 2027 World Women’s Championship.

events.title: Knitting, Knatters, & Crafts Circle
events.description: Join us for a fun and relaxing evening of crafting. We welcome all types of crafters. We often, but not always, have an instructor present who can teach anyone to knit or crochet. We have a good selection of free yarn you can choose from for your first project. We have “needles” you can learn on and take with you for free. (The “needles” are sharpened chopsticks or pencils.) If you want to learn to crochet, please bring a hook.

(Registration is not required, but you can sign up to receive an email reminder!)

events.title: Hooks 'N' Needles
events.description: Bring your projects and your questions! Our talented volunteer, Barb, will help your project take flight! We have yarn, needles, hooks and other supplies, or you can bring your own. This is a share and learn class with an opportunity to ask questions and get help with your project. Registration is not required but you can sign up to receive an email reminder or updates on any cancellations.

events.title: Open to Business – Free Business Assistance
events.description: Free, confidential business counseling to current and prospective entrepreneurs. Every first Monday of each month. Walk-in/drop-in welcome. The Open to Business program provides direct technical assistance and other forms of support to small business owners and entrepreneurs. All current business owners and aspiring entrepreneurs intending to establish, purchase or improve a business within the county are eligible and encouraged to participate. Appointment is not required but highly encouraged. Open to Business is a partnership between Ramsey County and the Metropolitan Consortium of Community
